audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows disagree between layers. Full reads LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Skill/Skill/Skill; content win[] and the packet both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Annie/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Annie. The full layer had LeBlanc winning levels 1-3 and the level 6 spike merely even — exactly backwards.
audit.why: LeBlanc pays 50 mana for a Sigil she cannot detonate without a second cast, so levels 1-3 are even. Level 4-5 is Annie's because Distortion is 15s at rank 1 and a point-and-click stun inside 625 needs no aim. Level 6 and first item are LeBlanc's because Mimic is 45s and doubles a spell while Annie's R is 130s. Two items swings back on Tibbers' fight presence.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Skill/Skill/Skill/Annie/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Annie in the full layer, matching content. Ratings 5/5/5/6/3/3/6.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why described Annie's spikes on rows the chart gives to LeBlanc.
audit.why: Mimic on a 45s cooldown at rank 1 lets her run the combo twice; Annie's Tibbers is 130s at rank 1. The relative spike ownership at 6 and at first item is hers.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to state the 45s-versus-130s asymmetry and the risk-free return charge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image was never mentioned anywhere on the page, and Ethereal Chains' 1.5-second leash was never mentioned either. Both are the decisive interactions in this lane. The page also called LeBlanc "he" in five fields.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: below 40% health she turns invisible for 1 second and leaves a clone that deals no damage. A stocked Pyromania spent on that clone is the single most expensive mistake available to Annie here, and nothing on the page warned about it. Riot's E text: the shackle only roots if it holds for 1.5 seconds — Molten Shield's move-speed burst is the counterplay, and it doubles as a Pyromania stack.
audit.corrected: Mirror Image now drives tldr, enemyWin, tradeBad, dontsFull[0] and breakdown.trading. The chain leash drives phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said "she is broke after it" with no numbers.
audit.why: Distortion is 15s at rank 1 for 60 mana, and once the return charge is spent she is stranded for the remainder. That is the concrete window, not a vibe about her mana.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the 15s/60-mana figures and the Ethereal Chains counterplay.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags spikes[0].text "Sigil of Malice-" as a probable wrong name; it is correct and the hyphen is just the compound. Left alone.
